verdict.rationale: No evidence shows a LiveKit Cloud free tier or free usage allowance; the pricing-page items cover per-minute cost previews and paid features only. LiveKit does document an open-source server with a `--dev` mode and a path to start on open source and move to Cloud later. That gives a no-cost route for development and early testing, though the evidence never states it in pricing terms. Missing for 10: an explicit free Cloud tier or free usage allowance, documented free-tier limits (minutes, participants, agent sessions), and independent confirmation that the free usage covers early testing.

support.subject: As a founder, a free tier or free usage allowance covers development and early testing

citations.quote: LiveKit is an open-source platform for building voice, video, and physical AI agents.
Start LiveKit in development mode by running `livekit-server --dev`. It'll use a placeholder API key/secret pair.
You can start on open source and migrate to LiveKit Cloud without rewriting application code.
